verdict.rationale: Asaas is a payments platform for which an official CLI is a plausible offering, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a REST API, a sandbox, a docs MCP server and llms.txt, with no mention of an official command-line tool. Those are adjacent AI-access features, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
